import sqlite3, json, datetime
U = lambda t: datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(t + 3*3600, datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%H:%M")
c = sqlite3.connect("file:/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall5.db?mode=ro", uri=True)
paths = c.execute("select ts,symbol,entry,path from paths").fetchall()
rows = c.execute("select id,ts_open,symbol,exit_type,entry,net_pct,hold_sec,lo_pct,lo_sec,hi_pct,hi_sec,parts from trades order by id").fetchall()
print("№ пара вход  итог net | макс в позиции % на с | первый раз >0 / >=+0.10 / >=+0.20 (с) | макс за все 30 мин % на с | мин в позиции % на с | выход")
out = []
for tid, t0, sym, how, e, net, hold, lo, los, hi, his, parts in rows:
    pa = next((p for p in paths if p[1] == sym and abs(p[0]-t0) < 600 and abs(p[2]-e)/e < 1e-6), None)
    pts = json.loads(pa[3]) if pa else []
    first = lambda th: next((t for t, b in pts if (b/e-1)*100 > th) if th <= 0 else ((t, b) for t, b in pts if (b/e-1)*100 >= th), None)
    def fst(th):
        for t, b in pts:
            r = (b/e-1)*100
            if (r > 0 if th == 0 else r >= th): return t
        return None
    fmax = max(pts, key=lambda x: x[1]) if pts else None
    f = lambda v: "—" if v is None else "%d" % v
    print("#%-2d %-5s %s %+.2f%% | %+.2f%% на %4.0f | %s / %s / %s | %s | %+.2f%% на %.0f | %s" % (
        tid, sym[:-4], U(t0), net*100, hi, his, f(fst(0)), f(fst(0.10)), f(fst(0.20)),
        ("%+.2f%% на %d" % ((fmax[1]/e-1)*100, fmax[0])) if fmax else "—", lo, los, how))
    out.append((how, hi, his, fst(0), fst(0.10), fst(0.20), hold))
import statistics as st
print()
for name, sel in (("дошли до безубытка", [o for o in out if o[0].startswith("be")]), ("без безубытка", [o for o in out if not o[0].startswith("be")])):
    mx = [o[1] for o in sel]; tm = [o[2] for o in sel]
    print("%s (%d): макс в позиции %+.2f%% в среднем (от %+.2f до %+.2f), момент максимума: медиана %.0f с" % (name, len(sel), st.mean(mx), min(mx), max(mx), st.median(tm)))
